```sql
SELECT SUM(bl.quantity) AS total_bags_sold
FROM store.bill_lines bl
JOIN store.products p ON bl.scanned_gtin = p.has_gtin
WHERE p.product_name ILIKE '%atta%'
  AND p.pack_size = '5 kg'
  AND bl.bill_timestamp >= '2026-06-01'
  AND bl.bill_timestamp < '2026-07-01';
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bl.bill_id) AS shoppers_without_atta
FROM store.bill_lines bl
WHERE bl.scanned_gtin NOT IN (
    SELECT p.has_gtin
    FROM store.products p
    WHERE p.product_name ILIKE '%atta%'
      AND p.pack_size = '5 kg'
)
  AND bl.bill_timestamp >= '2026-06-01'
  AND bl.bill_timestamp < '2026-07-01'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM store.bill_lines bl2
    WHERE bl2.bill_id = bl.bill_id
      AND bl2.scanned_gtin IN (
          SELECT p.has_gtin
          FROM store.products p
          WHERE p.product_name ILIKE '%atta%'
            AND p.pack_size = '5 kg'
      )
  );
```

```sql
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN sa.shelf_status = 'on shelf' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DECIMAL / COUNT(*) AS on_shelf_availability
FROM store.shelf_audits sa
JOIN store.products p ON sa.of_product = p.has_sku
WHERE p.product_name ILIKE '%atta%'
  AND p.pack_size = '5 kg'
  AND sa.audit_timestamp >= '2026-06-01'
  AND sa.audit_timestamp < '2026-07-01';
```

```sql
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(bl.quantity), 0) AS lost_sales_units
FROM store.bill_lines bl
WHERE bl.scanned_gtin IN (
    SELECT p.has_gtin
    FROM store.products p
    WHERE p.product_name ILIKE '%atta%'
      AND p.pack_size = '5 kg'
)
  AND bl.bill_timestamp >= '2026-06-01'
  AND bl.bill_timestamp < '2026-07-01'
  AND bl.till_status = 'failed';
```
